issues_discovered: npm workspaces only honor 'overrides' declared in the ROOT package.json — a workspace-level overrides block (previously in web/package.json) is silently ignored once hoisted. Must live at repo root.

Workspace package.json 'name' fields are used by npm -w selector, NOT directory names, and web ('lc-psi') vs studio ('lcpsi') are nearly identical strings — real footgun. Plan recommended renaming studio to 'lc-psi-studio' but this was NOT done (deferred, low priority, only affects internal -w selectors since neither is published).
